name: Nurses' Station
narrativeOnEnter: A long medical counter runs the length of the room. Medicine cabinets line the wall behind it — most empty, some sealed. An old computer terminal sits in the corner, its amber screen still glowing faintly.

action.text:
A laminated reference card — yellowed but legible.

RECORDS VAULT — SYMBOL REFERENCE GUIDE
(For authorised staff only)

Patient intake symbols are filed in order:
Cross · Moon · Star · Eye

Match the symbols in that sequence on the vault cabinet to release the director's key.

A stack of patient charts. Most are redacted or water-damaged.

One legible entry reads:
'Patient 07 — behavioural changes noted following first treatment session. Patient remains agitated. Requesting review of Director Harlan's protocols.'

'Nursing staff password for terminal system: BLACKWOOD'

A long counter. Scattered across it: empty medication trays, a broken thermometer, a pen.

Something is carved into the countertop:
'If you're reading this, find the vault.
Director Harlan's year of opening = safe code.
Blackwood opened: 1972.'
